events.evidence: Multiple explosions hit Shiite shrines in Baghdad and Karbala on the Shia festival of Ashura. Over 180 people are reported killed.
The European Union imposes additional 5% tariffs on a wide range of goods imported from the United States
Bernard Ebbers, ex-CEO of Worldcom, is indicted on three counts of conspiracy for his alleged role in that company's accounting scandal

label.note: Ashura bombings and EU tariffs dominate; Worldcom indictment adds corporate concern.
